1.1.3.2-f10.text: Anacreon’s cicada, sine sanguine & dolore, similes fere diis sunt

translations.note: 'Anacreon's cicada' is Burton's English, so it is not translated. The Latin echoes the Anacreontic ode to the cicada, which calls it bloodless, free of suffering and almost like the gods. Synesius quotes that ode in his Praise of Baldness.
